subject_required: None mandatory. Computing A level receives favourable consideration.
additional_conditions: Students applying with A level Computing will receive favourable consideration. All candidates considered individually.
document_text: Newcastle A level entry requires AAB, excluding General Studies and Critical Thinking. No specific subject is mandatory but students with A level Computing will receive favourable consideration. GCSE Mathematics minimum grade B or 6 required.

subject_required: Standard Level Maths grade 5 if not at Higher Level
additional_conditions: Standard Level Mathematics required at grade 5 if Maths not offered at Higher Level. GCSE Maths B/6 assumed to apply - verify with university.
document_text: Newcastle IB entry requires 34 points. Standard Level Mathematics at grade 5 is required if Mathematics is not offered at Higher Level.

subject_required: Accepted T levels: Digital Production, Design and Development; Digital Business Services; Digital Support Services; Design, Surveying and Planning for Construction; Healthcare Science; Science
excluded_subjects: All T levels not listed in accepted subjects
additional_conditions: Accepted on a case by case basis only. Contact university to discuss.
document_text: Newcastle accepts the following T levels on a case by case basis for CS: Digital Production, Design and Development; Digital Business Services; Digital Support Services; Design, Surveying and Planning for Construction; Healthcare Science; and Science. GCSE Mathematics minimum grade B or 6 required. Students should contact the university to discuss their specific T level.

subject_required: National 5 Maths grade B minimum if not at Higher
additional_conditions: Maths required at National 5 minimum grade B, or grade 2 Standard Grade, or Intermediate 2 equivalent, if not offered at Higher Grade. Where candidate bypasses National 5 assessment, minimum grade C in Higher Mathematics required. Combinations of Highers and Advanced Highers accepted. Can be taken in more than one sitting. GCSE Maths B/6 assumed to apply - verify with university.
document_text: Newcastle Scottish entry requires AAABB at Higher Grade. Mathematics is required at National 5 minimum grade B (or grade 2 Standard Grade or Intermediate 2 equivalent) if not offered at Higher Grade. Where a candidate bypasses National 5 assessment, minimum grade C in Higher Mathematics is required. Combinations of Highers and Advanced Highers are accepted and qualifications can be taken in more than one sitting.

subject_required: Ordinary Level Maths grade O2 if not at Higher Level
additional_conditions: Ordinary Level Mathematics required at grade O2 if Mathematics not offered at Higher Level. GCSE Maths B/6 assumed to apply - verify with university.
document_text: Newcastle Irish Leaving Certificate entry requires H1H1H2H2H3. Ordinary Level Mathematics at grade O2 is required if Mathematics is not offered at Higher Level.

headline_grade: D3, D3, M2 in Principal Subjects
document_text: Newcastle Cambridge Pre-U entry requires D3, D3, M2 in Principal Subjects. GCSE Mathematics minimum grade B or 6 required.

headline_grade: Considered as part of application profile
additional_conditions: EPQ will be taken into account as part of application profile but will not usually be included in offer conditions. GCSE Maths B/6 assumed to apply - verify with university.
document_text: Newcastle welcomes EPQ applications and values the research and independent learning skills it develops. The EPQ will be taken into account as part of the application profile but will not usually be included in offer conditions for the CS degree programme. GCSE Mathematics minimum grade B or 6 assumed to apply.

additional_conditions: Also accepted: OCR Cambridge Technical Level 3 Extended Diploma. Minimum grade B or 6 in at least five GCSEs required including Mathematics.
document_text: Newcastle BTEC Level 3 National Extended Diploma or OCR Cambridge Technical Level 3 Extended Diploma entry requires D*DD. Minimum grade B or 6 in at least five GCSEs required including Mathematics.

subject_required: Level 3 unit in mathematical studies essential. Science subject required.
additional_conditions: A Level 3 unit in mathematical studies is essential. At least 45 Level 3 credits at Distinction in a science subject required. GCSE Maths B/6 assumed to apply - verify with university.
document_text: Newcastle Access to HE entry requires at least 45 Level 3 credits at Distinction in a science subject. A Level 3 unit in mathematical studies is essential. GCSE Mathematics minimum grade B or 6 assumed to apply.

headline_grade: Up to 3 grades below standard offer
additional_conditions: Routes: PARTNERS, Realising Opportunities, Pathways to Newcastle, Contextual Offer, High Performance Athletes.
document_text: Newcastle offers alternative offers up to 3 grades lower than standard requirements through several routes: PARTNERS (for underrepresented backgrounds), Realising Opportunities (Year 12 programme with 10 research universities), Pathways to Newcastle (national skills entry route for specific subjects), Contextual Offer (based on UCAS contextual data), and High Performance Athletes scheme.

subject_required: None mandatory. Computing A level receives favourable consideration.
additional_conditions: PARTNERS scheme for students from underrepresented backgrounds. Excludes General Studies and Critical Thinking.
document_text: Newcastle PARTNERS A level offer requires BBC, excluding General Studies and Critical Thinking. Students with A level Computing will receive favourable consideration. GCSE Mathematics minimum grade B or 6 required. PARTNERS is one of the largest support entry routes for students from underrepresented backgrounds.

subject_required: National 5 Maths grade B if not at Higher
additional_conditions: PARTNERS scheme. Maths required at National 5 minimum grade B if not at Higher. Combinations of Highers and Advanced Highers accepted. Can be taken in more than one sitting.
document_text: Newcastle PARTNERS Scottish offer requires BBBCC at Higher Grade. Mathematics required at National 5 minimum grade B (or grade 2 Standard Grade or Intermediate 2 equivalent) if not offered at Higher Grade. Combinations of Highers and Advanced Highers accepted. Qualifications can be taken in more than one sitting.

additional_conditions: PARTNERS scheme. Also accepted: OCR Cambridge Technical Level 3 Extended Diploma. Minimum grade B or 6 in at least five GCSEs including Mathematics.
document_text: Newcastle PARTNERS BTEC Level 3 National Extended Diploma or OCR Cambridge Technical Level 3 Extended Diploma offer requires DDD. Minimum grade B or 6 in at least five GCSEs including Mathematics required.

subject_required: None mandatory. Computing A level receives favourable consideration.
additional_conditions: Contextual offer based on UCAS contextual data. Excludes General Studies and Critical Thinking.
document_text: Newcastle contextual A level offer requires BBB, excluding General Studies and Critical Thinking. Students with A level Computing will receive favourable consideration. GCSE Mathematics minimum grade B or 6 required. Eligibility based on contextual data from UCAS application considering challenges faced in education.

subject_required: None mandatory. Computing A level receives favourable consideration.
additional_conditions: Must successfully complete the Realising Opportunities programme. Programme open to Year 12 students, delivered across 10 research-intensive universities.
document_text: Newcastle Realising Opportunities A level offer requires BBB excluding General Studies and Critical Thinking, plus successful completion of the Realising Opportunities programme. Students with A level Computing will receive favourable consideration. GCSE Mathematics minimum grade B or 6 required. Realising Opportunities is a programme for Year 12 students delivered across 10 leading research-intensive UK universities.

subject_required: None mandatory. Computing A level receives favourable consideration.
additional_conditions: Must successfully complete Pathways to Newcastle online module. Available for specific subject areas only.
document_text: Newcastle Pathways to Newcastle A level offer requires BBB excluding General Studies and Critical Thinking, plus successful completion of the Pathways to Newcastle online module. Students with A level Computing will receive favourable consideration. GCSE Mathematics minimum grade B or 6 required. Pathways to Newcastle is a national skills entry route available for specific subject areas.

subject_required: National 5 Maths grade B if not at Higher
additional_conditions: Must successfully complete Pathways to Newcastle online module. Maths required at National 5 minimum grade B if not at Higher. Combinations of Highers and Advanced Highers accepted.
document_text: Newcastle Pathways to Newcastle Scottish offer requires BBBBB at Higher Grade plus successful completion of the Pathways to Newcastle online module. Mathematics required at National 5 minimum grade B (or grade 2 Standard Grade or Intermediate 2 equivalent) if not offered at Higher Grade. Combinations of Highers and Advanced Highers accepted and can be taken in more than one sitting.
